title: Build a source-derived IFX Profile bundle candidate
goal: Construct and statically validate an exact, source-bound IFX Profile candidate without self-approval, composition or activation.
acceptanceCriteria: The candidate is separate from the released V4 package and existing installations and binds exact IFX source identities and hashes.
The candidate manifest, Profile and complete sorted file inventory validate against the released 1.1.1 contracts.
All unmapped IFX gates and capability decisions are explicit; no accepted review record, composition or cutover is created.
